title: Task Scheduler / Cron: Complete Low Level Design
description: Design a delayed/scheduled job system with cron support, persistence, and retries.

data.text: Design a task scheduler that can run one-time and recurring jobs using cron expressions, with retries and persistence.

data.title: C# - Key Classes

items: Use a priority queue by next execution time
Parse cron with a library or custom parser
Persist jobs for recovery after restart
Use worker pool for execution with timeout/retries

data.title: Key Takeaways
data.takeaway: Separate scheduling, storage, and execution concerns.
